name: Kalyani Cast-Tech Ltd.
summary: Kalyani Cast-Tech Ltd. manufactures cargo containers and castings. It manufactures wide product range of castings, including finished components, cargo containers and other special containers including dwarf containers, cuboid containers, special containers for parcel cargo and containers for two and three wheelers. The company was founded by Naresh Kumar on September 26, 2012 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.
